2226-6751-8306.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-6751-8306.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Keymaster Rogue by paying its mana cost.
When Keymaster Rogue enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

240-2511-5470-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

883-4681-5170-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

997-2586-3197.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5567-6254-6495--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5567-6254-6495--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
4550-5567-6254-6495--112.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5663-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Cayth.
When Cayth dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cayth enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

252-1753-4231-5394.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-1753-4231-5394.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4364-7917.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2034-4364-7917.description:
Declare Aurelia and Seluma as attackers. Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Aurelia.
Deal combat damage using Seluma. Seluma triggers, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

967-2292-3809-7087-7824.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2446-3259-6968.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2446-3259-6968.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1591-2459-3652-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1591-2459-3652-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6604-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
3532-5078-6604-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

813-3617-7631.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1987-3821-7487.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-3821-7487.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Zealous Lorecaster and Peregrine Drake.
When Zealous Lorecaster and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1987-3821-7487.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

3617-4823-5144.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Timeless Witness and exiling Ephemerate.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a brain counter on it
with a brain counter on it

1247-5536-7308.description:
Activate Rex using Mona Lisa's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

803-3951-5334-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2267-4050-5058.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1363-1636-5865.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast Flamecache Gecko.
You control at least one additional creature,
1363-1636-5865.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn
1363-1636-5865.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying {1}{R}.
When Flamecache Gecko enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Flamecache Gecko trigger, adding {B}{R}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Flamecache Gecko and one other creature you control, returning Flamecache Gecko from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1363-1636-5865.notes: If you control creature(s) that can tap to produce mana, you can use that mana to pay for the creature and instead gain mana from the creature's ETB ability.

4050-4616-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4050-4616-6249--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

1762-2034-5173-5626.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, adding {C}{C}.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Wilhelt's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wilhelt trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token with decayed.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing the Zombie token, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1284-2178-4227.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1284-2178-4227.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

570-747-1636-3476.notablePrerequisites:
Faeburrow Elder and Go-Shintai do not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken Shrine.
You control a black and a red permanent.
570-747-1636-3476.description:
Activate Phantatog's first ability by sacrificing another nontoken Shrine, causing Phantatog to get +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Go-Shintai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning any Shrine from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the Shrine enters the battlefield, Go-Shintai triggers, creating a 1/1 Shrine enchantment creature token.
When the Shrine token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1494-4013-4802.notablePrerequisites: Master Biomancer has power five or greater.
1494-4013-4802.description:
Activate Eldazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Sage of Hours and causing it to enter the battlefield with five or more +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

903-2199-3481.description:
Cast Safe Passage by paying {2}{W}, preventing all damage dealt to you and creatures you control this turn.
Activate Frenetic Efreet an arbitrarily large number of times by paying a total of {0}.
Resolve the first Frenetic Efreet ability, flipping a coin and either sacrificing Frenetic Efreet or causing it to phase out.
If you won the flip, Karplusan Minotaur's first ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
If you lost the flip, Karplusan Minotaur's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target of an opponent's choice.
If the opponent chooses you or a creature you control to be dealt damage, Safe Passage prevents that damage.
Resolve the next Frenetic Efreet ability, flipping a coin and not sacrificing Frenetic Efreet or causing it to phase out due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2459-2834-4763.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {C}{C}.
Rograkh dies, triggering Koll, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Rograkh enters the battlefield, triggering Hero's Blade, attaching Hero's Blade to Rograkh.
Repeat.
